name: Re-Udemonia -Take a Step Backward-
source:
He chased her around the park in a game. But the game was confusing. 
"If you can catch me, I'll leave you alone!" 

In this world, saying I love you is mundane. Commonplace. 
It's not the same as saying I'm happy. 

Play as protagonist Shigeru as he spends 7 conflicted days with girlfriend Yuka - or is that really what she is? 

Experience the shyness, laughter, and rainbow of emotions as a couple, and think of what happiness means. 

- Help Shigeru find his happiness 
- Abandon logic and rely on your physical feeling 
- Your eyes, ears and heart will tell you what's right 

RE-udemonia 
A compelling ADV game about young love 

[from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE070101.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
他在公园里玩追逐游戏，女孩对他说：“你要是能抓住我，我就放过你！”

在这个世界里，说“我爱你”是再平常不过的事，但这和说“我很高兴”并不一样。

你将扮演主角茂，与女友由香度过充满矛盾的7天——但她真的是你的女友吗？

体验情侣之间的羞涩、欢笑和彩虹般的情感，思考幸福究竟意味着什么。

• 帮助茂找到幸福。
• 放弃逻辑，依靠身体感受。
• 让眼睛、耳朵和心灵告诉你什么才是正确的。

《Re-Udemonia：后退一步》是一款关于年轻爱情的引人入胜的冒险游戏。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE070101.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
